test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As on September 2021, who is the CEO of NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabh Kant.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• Amitabh Kant__ is the present CEO of Niti Aayog.
 
• He is the author of Branding India - An Incredible Story.
 
• He is the recipient of the One Globe Award-2016 for leadership in Transforming Governance for the 21st Century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Shri Parameswaran Iyer is the current Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Niti Aayog:

 
 
• It is a policy** think tank **of the Government of India.
 
• It is neither a constitutional body nor a statutory body
 
• **The Chairperson is the Prime Minister of India.**
 
• **Suman Bery is the Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog.**
 
• NITI Aayog is a policy think tank of the Government of India which replaced** the Planning Commission of India.**
 
• It was established with the aim of achieving sustainable development goals with cooperative federalism by fostering the involvement of State Governments in economic policies.
